title: Replace audio file uploads with URL inputs for both Audio 1 and Audio 2 slots

requirements.text: In frontend/src/components/ChapterForm.tsx, replace both Audio 1 and Audio 2 file upload inputs (and their associated progress bars, file-upload state, and chunked-upload logic) with plain text URL input fields. Audio 1 must have a text input for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 1 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and an adjacent optional label field (placeholder: 'Audio 1 Label'). Audio 2 must have a text input for the audio URL (placeholder: 'Audio 2 URL — any link (YouTube, Google Drive, direct, etc.)') and an adjacent optional label field (placeholder: 'Audio 2 Label'). Remove all File state variables, chunked-upload calls (uploadAudioChunk, uploadAudioChunk2, finalizeAudioUpload, finalizeAudioUpload2), upload progress state, and upload progress bar UI elements related to audio. The Save button flow must no longer perform any audio upload steps — chapter metadata (including the two audio URL strings and their labels) is saved directly via createChapter or updateChapter. Saving a chapter with only a title must still work; all audio URL fields remain optional.

quotes: every link and yes for both
switch both Audio 1 and Audio 2 slots from file uploads to URL/link inputs that accept any type of link

acceptanceCriteria: ChapterForm shows a URL text input and a label text input for Audio 1.
ChapterForm shows a URL text input and a label text input for Audio 2.
No file input, file state, progress bar, or chunked-upload logic for audio exists anywhere in ChapterForm.
Entering any URL (YouTube, Google Drive, direct .mp3/.mp4, etc.) in either audio URL field and saving persists the URL to the canister via createChapter/updateChapter.
audioLabel1 and audioLabel2 values are included in the chapter payload sent to the canister.
When editing an existing chapter, the audio URL fields are pre-populated with the stored URL values.
The Save button is not disabled by empty audio URL fields; a chapter with only a title saves successfully.
No import or usage of audioUploadService.ts or audioUploadService2.ts remains in ChapterForm.tsx.
The save progress indicator no longer includes audio upload chunk steps; it reflects only metadata create/update.

requirements.text: Update the Chapter page Audio tab in frontend/src/pages/ChapterPage.tsx and the AudioPlayer component in frontend/src/components/AudioPlayer.tsx to play audio using the stored URL strings (audioUrl, audioUrl1, or audioUrl2 fields on the Chapter object) directly — without fetching binary data from the canister. When a chapter has one or two audio URLs, the Audio tab must show named buttons/cards for each available audio item using the admin-entered label (audioLabel1 / audioLabel2), falling back to 'Audio 1' / 'Audio 2'. Clicking a named button passes the corresponding URL string directly to the AudioPlayer for playback. Remove any calls to getAudioData or getAudioData2 canister functions, and remove any URL.createObjectURL / URL.revokeObjectURL logic that was used for binary audio blobs. The AudioPlayer must accept the URL as-is and attempt playback, displaying an error message only if the browser cannot load the resource. If no audio URL is stored for either slot, show the existing 'No audio available' empty-state UI.

quotes: every link and yes for both
update the audio playback on the Chapter page to use these URLs directly

acceptanceCriteria: The Audio tab on the Chapter page shows one button/card per available audio URL using the admin-entered label (fallback: 'Audio 1' / 'Audio 2').
Clicking an audio button passes the stored URL string to the AudioPlayer component for immediate playback.
No calls to getAudioData or getAudioData2 canister functions exist in ChapterPage.tsx.
No URL.createObjectURL or URL.revokeObjectURL calls related to audio exist in ChapterPage.tsx or AudioPlayer.tsx.
The AudioPlayer renders an <audio> element with the URL as its src, without any URL validation or filtering.
If neither audio slot has a URL, the 'No audio available' empty-state UI is displayed.
Audio playback works for YouTube links, Google Drive links, and direct audio URLs in supported browsers.

requirements.text: Update the Motoko backend (backend/main.mo) to ensure that the ChapterInput and Chapter types include audioUrl1 (Text) and audioUrl2 (Text) fields for storing the two audio URL strings, in addition to the existing audioLabel1 and audioLabel2 fields. Remove any backend functions or stable variables exclusively used for binary audio storage for the canister-side chunked upload feature (uploadAudioChunk, uploadAudioChunk2, finalizeAudioUpload, finalizeAudioUpload2, getAudioData, getAudioData2, deleteAudioData, deleteAudioData2) if they are no longer needed now that audio is stored as URLs. Preserve all other chapter fields and CRUD functions unchanged.

quotes: every link and yes for both

acceptanceCriteria: ChapterInput and Chapter types in backend/main.mo include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 as Text fields.
createChapter and updateChapter correctly store and return audioUrl1 and audioUrl2.
Binary audio upload/finalize/retrieve canister functions are removed from the actor if no longer referenced by the frontend.
All existing chapter CRUD operations (addChapter, updateChapter, deleteChapter, getChapter, getAllChapters) remain functional.
The canister compiles without errors after the changes.

requirements.text: Update frontend/src/utils/chapterMapper.ts to map the audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 backend fields to the frontend Chapter type, and update frontend/src/types/chapter.ts to include audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 as optional string fields on the Chapter interface. Remove any frontend references to hasAudio, hasAudio2, or binary audio blob fields that were used for the chunked upload feature.

quotes: every link and yes for both

acceptanceCriteria: The Chapter TypeScript interface in chapter.ts includes optional audioUrl1?: string and audioUrl2?: string fields.
chapterMapper.ts correctly maps backend audioUrl1 and audioUrl2 fields to the frontend Chapter type.
No references to hasAudio or hasAudio2 binary-audio flags remain in chapterMapper.ts or chapter.ts.
Existing fields (notesUrl1, notesLabel1, notesUrl2, notesLabel2, audioLabel1, audioLabel2, etc.) remain unchanged.

constraints: Do not change the audioLabel1 and audioLabel2 label fields — these remain as optional text inputs in ChapterForm.
Do not alter the Notes URL inputs or any quiz/flashcard fields in ChapterForm.
The Admin panel must remain open-access with no authentication.
The 'Sia' hidden admin entry point in TermsPage must remain unchanged.
Recently viewed and completed progress must remain in LocalStorage only — do not touch storageService.ts beyond removing audio-upload references.
Edit and Delete buttons must remain hidden from student-facing pages and visible only in the Admin Panel.
nonGoals: Adding YouTube embed iframes or custom video players — the AudioPlayer HTML5 audio element is used as-is.
Validating or restricting the format of audio URLs entered by the admin.
Migrating any existing binary audio data stored in the canister to URLs.
Changing the Notes URL inputs or their behavior.
